statement: A path resolved relative to the git toplevel is wrong in a linked worktree: the sibling-repository fallback in cejel's seed pre-commit validator was join(toplevel, '..', 'alfred'), which from ~/projects/cejel/.worktrees/<name> is .worktrees/alfred, so headless sessions (which cannot set ALFRED_REPO_ROOT) could not commit lesson seeds. Occurrence 2026-10-02: two cejel sessions (the #369/#370 rebase and the release driver) were blocked with maeve_staging_validator_unavailable. Rule: resolve sibling-repository paths from the main checkout (the directory holding git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir), keep explicit overrides authoritative, and make the failure name every path tried; test it from a synthetic linked worktree, since a main-checkout test cannot reproduce the defect.
